description: Source code for oseama utility handling Seama seal (container) files, including functions for reading, creating, and extracting entities within Seama files.

methods.name: oseama_info
methods.description: Displays information about a Seama file, including metadata entries and entity details.

methods.name: oseama_entity
methods.description: Creates or appends entities to a Seama file, including handling metadata and payload data.

methods.name: oseama_extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific entity from a Seama file to an output file.
